designHypothesis: Al-MOF stable scaffold plus defect-anchored Mo-oxo / pore-confined MoOx-like active-site hypothesis for 170C aqueous CO2 to formic acid / organic acids.
forbiddenClaims: proving Al/Mo is the optimal catalyst
hardRules: Do not describe the workflow as direct Al/Mo-MOF screening.
Stage 1 screens only Al-MOF stable scaffolds.
Stage 1 applies a hydrothermal hard gate at >=150C.
Candidates without >=150C hydrothermal evidence fail or need review before high-score recommendation.
Stage 2 recommends a second metal from the configured pool.
Do not use alOFrameworkCompatibility as a single governing score.
Resolve the second-metal mechanism into node substitution, defect anchoring, and pore confinement.
Represent Mo primarily as defect-anchored Mo-oxo or pore-confined MoOx-like species.
Use CRITIC+AHP weighting rather than pure CRITIC.
Keep chemically important descriptors at >=5% minimum weight.
Run 1000 Monte Carlo sensitivity iterations with +/-20% weight perturbation.
After every sensitivity perturbation, normalize the perturbed weights, recalculate DMRS for all metals, and re-sort the full metal pool.
If Mo rank is unchanged across all perturbations, label the result robust but audit-required rather than proof of Mo optimality.
Mark robust recommendation only when Mo Top 3 probability is >=85%.
Include Ru, Pd, and Ag blind baselines.
Explain Why Mo with a contribution waterfall.
Include pure Al-MOF, Mo-anchored Al-MOF, Al-MOF + MoOx physical mixture, MoOx alone, and blank controls.
Require post-reaction Mo K-edge XANES/EXAFS validation.
State metal-pool and missing-microkinetics limitations.
Show EXAFS expected fingerprints and falsification criteria before validation claims.
Mark blind-baseline negative evidence as evidence pending when no real DOI is available.
Use null for unavailable source DOI fields; no fake DOI is allowed.
Provide a reproducibility statement covering descriptor dictionary, CRITIC+AHP config, metal matrix, and sensitivity scripts.
